name: Grand Junction
card: The hub of the Grand Valley, where a lot of Western Slope searches start.
near: Fruita, Palisade, Clifton, and the Redlands sit around it.
metaTitle: Grand Junction Websites and Local SEO | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Websites and local SEO for Grand Junction businesses. $1,000 site build, monthly plans at $850 and $1,500, optional $150 care. No long-term contract.
body:
Grand Junction is the largest city on the Western Slope and the seat of Mesa County. A search here might be a homeowner in the Redlands, a shopper who also looks at Fruita, or a company that serves the whole valley.

I build the site and the Google listing around the services you want and the towns you will actually drive to. Grand Junction can be your main page without pretending you have an office in every nearby town.
extraQ: Should my Grand Junction site mention Fruita and Palisade?
extraA: Yes, if you truly serve them. Say so on a page that explains the work, and set the service area on your one Google listing. Do not create extra listings for those towns unless you have a real location there.
